strategy.name: Wyckoff_v3_WideOpen
strategy.rationale: v3: phase_confidence 0.45->0.35, R:R 1.6->1.3, RSI band 40-72 -> 35-78, ATR band 1.0-6.0 -> 0.7-8.0. The 200-DMA trend filter moves into the any-of tier (50-DMA now also qualifies) so early trend turns are catchable. Only hard blocks left: no confirmed markdown phase, no RSI above 78. Position limits (5), 70% exposure cap, 5-day max hold and 1.5% risk are UNCHANGED — MTF interest makes those non-negotiable.

reviews.lessons: The strategy has produced zero trades, which means the entry filter combination is too restrictive or the universe is too small — eight large-caps in a single market regime will rarely present all five simultaneous conditions (Wyckoff phase ≥0.55, volume confirming, R:R ≥1.8, ATR in band, RSI 40-72, above 200-DMA). A zero-trade record tells us nothing about stop placement or MTF drag, but it does confirm the system is over-fitted to an ideal setup that arrives infrequently. The R:R ≥1.8 threshold combined with the phase_confidence ≥0.55 gate is almost certainly the binding constraint — by the time a Wyckoff markup is confident AND the nearest resistance is 1.8× the stop distance, price has often already moved. No trades means zero learning about whether the core Wyckoff thesis actually generates alpha; the system cannot be validated or improved without at least some live signal.
reviews.changes: 1) Expand universe to 15-20 Nifty 50 names (add BAJFINANCE, HCLTECH, WIPRO, KOTAKBANK, MARUTI, TITAN, SUNPHARMA, BHARTIARTL, NESTLEIND, M&M) to increase the daily candidate pool. 2) Relax phase_confidence threshold from 0.55 to 0.45 — accept early-phase signals and let R:R and volume do the filtering instead. 3) Tighten R:R requirement to 1.6 minimum rather than 1.8; the 1.8 floor is sound in principle but paired with strict phase confidence it is redundant and kills frequency. 4) Add a secondary entry trigger: allow a stock that fails phase_confidence but shows a clean Spring or Last Point of Support on volume surge (volume_ratio >1.5× 20-day average) to qualify with R:R ≥2.0 — this captures the most reliable Wyckoff signal even if the composite score is low. 5) Keep max_hold_days at 5 and risk_per_trade at 1.5% — these are correct given MTF economics. 6) Once trades begin, track exit-reason distribution: if MAX_HOLD_5D exits outnumber STOP exits by more than 2:1, tighten phase_confidence back up; if STOP exits dominate, revisit stop placement relative to ATR.
